title: Signs a Growth Spurt is Coming
mascot_sheet: Character model sheet of Sneaky, a goofy red canvas high-top sneaker cartoon mascot. Sneaky has large expressive cartoon eyes on the front tongue, floppy white shoelaces that act as bendy noodle arms, a clean white rubber toe cap, and a white rubber sole. Full body standing front view, clean 2D vector animation style, thick black outlines, flat solid colors, plain white background, isolated.
voice: Energetic, fast, playful delivery with comedic timing
music: Bouncy, playful instrumental hip-hop cartoon beat with pizzicato strings, 124 BPM

scenes.vo: Your shoes are trying to tell you something.
scenes.bg: Warm yellow background with bold radiating comic sunburst lines
scenes.pose: Sneaky leaning forward with wide curious eyes, cupping lace hands around his mouth like whispering a secret

props.prompt: Cartoon floating magnifying glass focusing on Sneaky's toe

scenes.vo: First sign, your shoe size jumps rapidly!
scenes.bg: Bright orange backdrop with floating comic question marks and numbers
scenes.pose: Sneaky stretching his sole comically long with eyes popping out in surprise

props.prompt: Yellow cartoon measuring tape wrapping around Sneaky's sole

scenes.vo: Suddenly, you start tripping over everything.
scenes.bg: Flat pastel cyan floor with comical motion blur speed lines
scenes.pose: Sneaky with his own shoelace arms completely tangled together, tumbling clumsily with dizzy spiral eyes

scenes.vo: You eat snacks like a vacuum cleaner.
scenes.bg: Warm peach background with subtle comic kitchen shelf outlines
scenes.pose: Sneaky opening his sneaker tongue wide like an industrial vacuum hose, inhaling flying snacks

props.prompt: Floating stack of giant cartoon burgers and pizza slices

scenes.vo: And sleep all day on the weekend.
scenes.bg: Cozy muted purple bedroom wall with a sleepy crescent moon icon
scenes.pose: Sneaky curled up on a fluffy white pillow under a tiny blanket, blissfully snoring with floating Zzz letters

props.prompt: Floating digital cartoon clock glowing 11:30 AM

scenes.vo: Track your growth instead of guessing!
scenes.bg: Vibrant lime green background with bold vertical measurement lines
scenes.pose: Sneaky standing tall and proud, lace arm pointing confidently at a height ruler

props.prompt: Colorful cartoon height wall chart with bright tick marks

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.
scenes.bg: Clean gradient cyan backdrop with floating celebratory yellow stars
scenes.pose: Sneaky giving a joyful double thumbs-up with lace hands, beaming a huge confident cartoon smile

props.prompt: Smartphone mockup displaying TallPlan app growth tracker dashboard
